ops.text: These break the prompt cache: switching model (including a skill naming another model or a safety fallback), toggling fast mode, adding or removing MCP servers whose tools are not deferred, compaction. These keep it on the Anthropic API or a subscription: changing effort, invoking skills, spawning sub-agents, editing repo files.

List prices per million tokens, input/output: Fable 5.2 $8/$40, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 (Haiku alone costs more above a 100K-token prompt). Cache reads: $0.20, $0.20, $0.10, $0.01.

On defect search, an Opus 5.5 lead with Sonnet 5.5 helpers scored 0.831 at $139 against Opus alone 0.827 at $200 at medium (0.850 at $236 at high); a Fable 5.2 lead with Sonnet helpers scored 0.833 at $165, 19% more than the Opus lead.

Opus 5.5 at low effort scored 34 points below medium on an internal defect-search benchmark. Sonnet 5.5 on agentic coding went from 62.7% at medium to 77.8% at high. On deep research, Fable 5.2 high over low bought 3.3 points for 3.2 times the cost.
